extraction_note: Second pass (PC-05). 'a i ntervenit' and 'Leg ii' are split as converted. Three decisions follow (Nos 39, 25 and 15 of 2025, pages 33-34), not extracted separately.
intervention_as_stated: Decizii ale Consiliului de Administrație ARCOM privind accesul pe proprietăți (Legea nr. 28/2016)

text_en: Following these updates, the total number of entities that have submitted access conditions to ARCOM reached 218, contributing to greater transparency and predictability in granting access to property.
summary: The number of property holders that have submitted network access conditions to ARCOM reached 218, after 11 more in 2025.
extraction_note: Second pass (PC-05). 'a u' is split as converted. The preceding sentence gives 11 conditions submitted in 2025 by holders of public property, for publication on ARCOM's website.

text_en: The main violations found consisted of unauthorised provision of electronic communications networks, non-compliance with general authorisation conditions by network or service providers, late submission of periodic statistical reports or submission of incorrect information, and non-compliance with legal provisions on blocking prohibited web addresses or sites.
summary: Main violations found in 2025 inspections: unauthorised network provision, breaches of authorisation conditions, late or wrong statistical reports, and failure to block prohibited websites.
extraction_note: Second pass (PC-05). Follows the inspection count (item 0060). Theme doubtful for the same reason as item 0060 (inspections cover electronic communications and postal services); the violations listed concern electronic communications providers, and the website-blocking obligation concerns content rather than networks.

text_en: ARCOM also presented digital tools for informing and protecting consumers, such as the network coverage map, the mobile services offers comparator and the postal services comparator, as well as the support mechanisms offered to users through the Single Call Centre and the Consumer Protection Service.
summary: ARCOM presented its online consumer tools, including the network coverage map and a mobile offers comparator, at the April 2025 open internet workshop.
extraction_note: Second pass (PC-05). At the TAIEX regional open internet workshop of 8-9 April 2025 in Chișinău. 'A RCOM' and 'o ferte' are split as converted. Theme doubtful: public online tools for consumers on connectivity (coverage map, offers comparator); the postal comparator and the call centre in the same sentence are out of scope.
intervention_as_stated: Instrumente digitale ARCOM pentru consumatori: Harta acoperirii rețelelor, Comparatorul de oferte pentru servicii mobile

text_en: TAIEX workshop on implementing the Gigabit Infrastructure Act (19-20 June 2025, Brussels, Belgium), a multinational TAIEX workshop dedicated to implementing the Gigabit Infrastructure Act (GIA).
summary: ARCOM took part in a June 2025 multinational TAIEX workshop in Brussels on implementing the EU Gigabit Infrastructure Act.
extraction_note: Second pass (PC-05). Listed under TAIEX assistance used by ARCOM. Added as an EU alignment step (the first pass kept study visits and workshops where an alignment step is stated). The text adds that participation helped understand how to implement the GIA through secondary acts and monitoring; not extracted separately.
intervention_as_stated: Participarea la atelierul TAIEX privind implementarea Actului privind Infrastructura Gigabit (GIA)

text_en: The study visit on implementing the NIS2 Directive (9-11 April 2025, Brussels, Belgium), organised with the support of the German international cooperation agency (GIZ Moldova), aimed to assess the state of alignment of Eastern Partnership countries' national legislation with the requirements of the Directive on the security of network and information systems (NIS2).
summary: ARCOM joined an April 2025 GIZ-supported study visit to Brussels assessing Eastern Partnership countries' alignment with the NIS2 Directive.
extraction_note: Second pass (PC-05). Added for consistency with item 0068 (DSA study visit): the visit is framed as assessing alignment with an EU directive.
intervention_as_stated: Vizita de studiu privind implementarea Directivei NIS2

text_en: In the context of the opening of Moldova's accession negotiations with the EU, ARCOM continues to provide the necessary support for the negotiation process in its areas of competence.
summary: ARCOM continues to support Moldova's EU accession negotiations in its areas of competence.
